<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 10+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Tales in Timber](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2648)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 202

**Price** 850 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Wooden Breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=36)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Dozens of pictorial stories—told in wood carvings, painting, or pyrography—adorn every outer surface of this _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [wooden breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=36)_. All are old, and many truly ancient, depicting tales set eons ago on the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25). You gain a +2 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26). If you know the [_collective memories_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=15) ritual, you can use Nature instead of [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) if you're the primary caster.

**Activate—Statue Disguise** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (NULL);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor makes you look like a wooden statue version of one of the creatures depicted on the armor for 1 hour. This is a 3rd-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159), but it can make you look like any creature depicted on the armor. This doesn't change your size or the capabilities of your body, and it scales the appearance of the creature to match yours. You can Dismiss the activation. This disguise is just real enough to make you somewhat closer to a creature of wood. You're affected by two spells while it lasts: [_oaken resilience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=20) and [_speak with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=294). If you stand still, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks and DCs to appear as an inanimate wooden statue, in addition to the status bonus to Deception from _illusory disguise_.
